NHTSA has no information at this time as to the likelihood, or magnitude, of any of these shifts. An AFES's for NPA's both above and below 6,000 pounds GVWR are contemplated for model years beyond 1979.
The environmental impact of this alternative for each year beyond MY 1979 for which an AFES was proposed would be the same as the total environmental impact for the AFES for MY 1979, if the fuel economy level for the future years was the same as this standard. A higher level could increase the impact. However, setting AFES's for future years at a later date may result in greater gasoline and energy savings.
d. Setting the AFES at higher or lower levels.

Raising the AFES to a higher level could force the manufacturers to take actions that could result in the various market shifts discussed in alternative c.

This would defeat the intent of the AFES program. The environmental impact of a higher level AFES could be a reduction in gasoline and energy savings because of the market shifts. All other impacts are likely to be lower.
